title: Schemas and the schema registry: evolving an event without breaking a reader

videos.script: On Monday the tills get new software. One field has a new name. What used to be cents is now amount. {{rename}} The tills work. The sales arrive. Nothing fails anywhere. {{nothing}} But the program that adds up the money still looks for cents. It finds nothing, and it adds nothing. Recife sold four hundred reais that morning, and the report says it did not. {{report}} The producer and the reader never met. They only shared a guess about what a sale looks like, and one of them changed it. {{guess}} A schema writes that guess down. A registry keeps every version of it, numbered, and refuses the ones that would break a reader. {{registry}} In this lesson you install a registry beside your cluster. You send sales in Avro, with the schema's number inside every message. Then you try to rename a field, and watch the registry say no. {{no}}
